summary: The District has prevailed in a dispute with the Trump Administration over voter rolls, while facing significant federal expenditures and control related to an extended National Guard deployment in the city. Meanwhile, DC advocacy groups are highlighting threats to the District's fiscal independence and drawing attention to the constraints of federal oversight in Washington.
